scope: Field-block release notice and its guide only; no fluent review claimed. No lesson or quiz changes.

entries.source: Draw named field blocks and fill them with beds using your own dimensions and path widths.

drafts.zu: Dweba izingxenye zensimu ezinamagama bese uzigcwalisa ngemibhede usebenzisa ubukhulu bakho nobubanzi bezindlela.
drafts.st: Taka dikarolo tsa tshimo tse nang le mabitso mme o di tlatse ka dibethe tsa temo o sebedisa ditekanyo tsa hao le bophara ba ditselana.
drafts.ts: Dirowa swiphemu swa nsimu leswi nga ni mavito kutani u swi tata hi mibedo u tirhisa mipimo ya wena ni ku anama ka tindlela.
drafts.ve: Olani zwipiḓa zwa tsimu zwi re na madzina ni zwi ḓadze nga mibethe ni tshi shumisa mielo yaṋu na vhuphara ha nḓila.

entries.source: Keep a field open without beds and use both layouts in automatic crop planning.

drafts.zu: Shiya ingxenye yensimu ivulekile ingenamibhede, bese usebenzisa zombili izinhlelo ekuhleleni izitshalo okuzenzakalelayo.
drafts.st: Tlohela karolo ya tshimo e bulehile e se na dibethe tsa temo, mme o sebedise meralo ka bobedi moralong wa dijalo o iketsang.
drafts.ts: Siya xiphemu xa nsimu xi pfulekile xi nga ri na mibedo, kutani u tirhisa malulamiselo hamambirhi eka ku kunguhata swibyariwa loku tiendlekelaka.
drafts.ve: Litshani tshipiḓa tsha tsimu tsho vulea tshi si na mibethe, ni shumise nzudzanyo dzoṱhe mbili kha u pulana zwiliṅwa hu ḓiendelaho.

drafts.st: Moralo wa sebaka → Ho lema → Dikarolo tsa tshimo
drafts.ts: Dizayini ya ndhawu → Ku byala → Swiphemu swa nsimu
drafts.ve: Dizaini ya fhethu → U ṱavha → Zwipiḓa zwa tsimu

entries.source: Draw a polygon, choose beds or open field, save the layout and open the automatic crop planner.

drafts.zu: Dweba umumo onamakhona, khetha imibhede noma insimu evulekile, gcina uhlelo bese uvula umhleli wezitshalo ozenzakalelayo.
drafts.st: Taka sebopeho se nang le dikgutlo, kgetha dibethe tsa temo kapa tshimo e bulehileng, boloka moralo mme o bule moralo wa dijalo o iketsang.
drafts.ts: Dirowa xivumbeko lexi nga ni tikhona, hlawula mibedo kumbe nsimu leyi pfulekeke, hlayisa malulamiselo kutani u pfula xipulani xa swibyariwa lexi tiendlekelaka.
drafts.ve: Olani tshivhumbeo tshi re na khuḓa, khethani mibethe kana tsimu yo vuleaho, vhulungani nzudzanyo ni vule mupulani wa zwiliṅwa ane a ḓiendela.
